guidance: Write so a trained newcomer can execute without tribal knowledge. Steps are ordered and concrete. Call out failure-prone details per step. Checklist items are binary verifications. Avoid policy essays—stay procedural.

outline.title: Purpose & Scope
outline.guidance: Why this process exists and who owns it.

children.title: Why It Matters
children.guidance: Why this process exists and what fails if done incorrectly.

children.title: Step
children.guidance: Title each instance with the step action, not "Step".

children.title: Watch Outs
children.guidance: Common mistakes or important details for this step. Omit if none.

outline.title: Quality Checklist
outline.guidance: Binary verifications before the process is complete.

children.title: Verification
children.guidance: Title each instance with the check item, not "Verification".

children.title: Review Item
children.guidance: What to confirm before the process is complete.
